title: MC Cubed
description: A vanilla+ mod pack that aims to expand the game while staying true to original Minecraft. Adds many QoL, Optimization, sound and GUI mods!
body:
A mod pack for muh small minecraft server.

_Minecraft Cubed is a carefully curated modpack that enhances the vanilla Minecraft experience by introducing immersive sounds and visuals, enriched exploration, and quality-of-life improvements, all while maintaining the core essence of the game._


**Mod Permissions**: All mods included in this pack are either open-source, have permissions granted by their authors, or are hosted on Modrinth, complying with Modrinth's content guidelines.
